cards.lore: Go everywhere on the map. Prove to the machine that you have surveyed every inch of your own cage.
cards.name: Cartography Sidequest
cards.power: Weaponized FOMO: Target opponent must skip their next turn to draw cards they are not allowed to look at.

cards.lore: Reach the end of the level. Your reward is a slightly harder level.
cards.name: Level Goal
cards.power: Goalpost Shift — Move target opponent’s victory token back three spaces.

cards.lore: Find an exit to the level. Spoiler: there is no outside.
cards.name: The Maze
cards.power: Cognitive Loop — Force opponent to shuffle their hand into deck and redraw one less.

cards.lore: Ascend to the top of a tower to fight a guy who could have just met you in the lobby.
cards.name: It’s All Upstairs From Here
cards.power: False Summit — Cancel an opponent’s action just as it resolves.

cards.lore: Go fast or don’t stop. The illusion of choice, accelerated.
cards.name: Run or Die
cards.power: Panic Attack — Opponent must play their next card in 3 seconds or discard it.

cards.lore: Run away from danger until you reach safety. Safety is cutscene.
cards.name: Escape Sequence
cards.power: Scripted Collapse — Destroy a resource in play. Everyone starts running.

cards.lore: Climb up until you reach safety. Gravity is now microaggression.
cards.name: Rise to the Challenge
cards.power: Rising Sludge — Discard the bottom three cards of everyone’s deck.

cards.lore: You cannot pass until the developers finish coding the next zone.
cards.name: Broken Bridge
cards.power: Arbitrary Roadblock — Target opponent cannot attack or advance until they sacrifice a high-value card.

cards.lore: Defeat a challenging monster who exists solely to gatekeep your dopamine.
cards.name: Boss Battle
cards.power: Sponge Mechanics — Absorb the next 3 attacks directed at you.

cards.lore: Kill all the monsters in an area. You are the janitor of death.
cards.name: Kill Enemies to Open
cards.power: Blood Lock — Opponent cannot draw new cards until they destroy one of their own items.

cards.lore: Kill many of the same monster. Because repetitive labor is fun when it’s violent.
cards.name: Mass Monster-Slaughter
cards.power: POWER Grindfest — Play the same low-level attack three times in a row.

cards.lore: Retrieve random drops for an NPC. The pinnacle of heroic fetch quests.
cards.name: 20 Bear Asses
cards.power: Macabre Fetch — Steal a random resource card.

cards.lore: Kill everyone on a list of targets, a psychopath’s grocery run.
cards.name: Gotta Kill Them All
cards.power: Target a specific card in opponent’s deck; if drawn, it is instantly destroyed.

cards.lore: Kill so many enemies as you can without getting hit. Perfect for your ego.
cards.name: Kill Streak
cards.power: Momentum — For every card you played last turn, draw an extra card this turn.

cards.lore: Defeat the computer who is controlling the game against you. He too always wins.
cards.name: Player Versus Environment
cards.power: System Update — Change the current rules of the game randomly for one round.

cards.lore: Defeat another player who is likewise trying to defeat you. Keep the plates spinning and cheer.
cards.name: Player Versus Player
cards.power: Divide and Conquer — Force opponents to discard a card of each other’s choosing.

cards.lore: Help a weak ally navigate a dangerous area. The ultimate test of your patience.
cards.name: Escort Mission
cards.power: Suicidal AI — Attach this to an opponent; they must spend one action per turn protecting it or lose 5 points.

cards.lore: Save all the allies in distress. A hoarding pathology disguised as altruism.
cards.name: Gotta Rescue Them All
cards.power: Guilt Trip — Opponent cannot play attack cards while you have cards in your hand.

cards.lore: Survive by not letting the enemy win. Stand in this circle until we say you can leave.
cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.power: Attrition — Neither you nor your opponent can draw cards for 2 turns.

cards.lore: Rescue someone who’s been kidnapped. Again. Try harder next time.
cards.name: Save the Princess
cards.power: Damsel Tax — Steal an opponent’s highest-value card and hide it until they defeat it.

cards.lore: Retrieve one or more NPC coupons. Because we need a reason to send you to the other side.
cards.name: Fetch Quest
cards.power: Busywork — Opponent must discard two cards to draw one card.

cards.lore: The classic trade chain: trade a paperclip for a house. Mostly you get scammed.
cards.name: Chain of Deals
cards.power: Trade Trap — Swap hands with an opponent, then randomly swap one card back.

cards.lore: Deliver a fragile item across the map. Weather, bandits, physics—everything hates you.
cards.name: Product Delivery Ordeal
cards.power: Fragile Cargo — Your next action fails unless you discard a card.

cards.lore: Collect three ancient artifacts to open the door. Then another door appears.
cards.name: Plot Coupons
cards.power: Gatekeeper — Opponent cannot play high-value cards until they discard one.

cards.lore: Collect all the items or live items. Turning wildlife preservation into a hostage situation.
cards.name: Gotta Catch Them All
cards.power: Compulsive Capture — Take control of an opponent’s weakest card permanently.

cards.lore: Herd animals into an area. Because AI pathfinding is a joke we play on you.
cards.name: Herding Mission
cards.power: Pathing Error — Opponent’s cards are played on the wrong targets this turn.

cards.lore: Gather a group of NPCs together. Wrangling digital toddlers.
cards.name: NPC Round-Up Mission
cards.power: Cat Herding — Opponent must reveal their hand and shuffle it back into their deck.

cards.lore: Stuffing living creatures into your infinite backpack. Don’t think about it.
cards.name: Live Items
cards.power: Inventory Bite — Discard a resource; if it bites you, take 1 damage.

cards.lore: Earn your ally’s favor. Friendship is transactional.
cards.name: Companion-Specific Sidequest
cards.power: Bribed Loyalty — Sacrifice a card to draw two extra cards.

cards.lore: Complete your ally’s personal quest so they don’t betray you at the finale.
cards.name: Loyalty Mission
cards.power: Trauma Dump — Opponent must skip their turn to listen to your backstory.

cards.lore: Earn your ally’s love. Select dialogue options to achieve affection.
cards.name: Romance Sidequest
cards.power: Simulated Love — Force an opponent’s card to fight for you for one round.

cards.lore: A shiny hat to validate your hundred hours of meaningless grinding.
cards.name: Cosmetic Award
cards.power: Shiny Distraction — Negate all damage this turn if your cards look ridiculous.

cards.lore: Solve a puzzle because the ancient architect loved pushing blocks around.
cards.name: Stock Video Game Puzzle
cards.power: Sliding Blocks — Rearrange the top 5 cards of any deck.

cards.lore: Play a smaller game within the game. Pacing is a myth.
cards.name: Mini-Game
cards.power: Distraction Game — Both players must roll a die; highest roll steals a card.

cards.lore: Why save the world when you could be taking photos of frogs?
cards.name: Variable Player Goals
cards.power: Goal Fragmentation — Change the win condition of the game for 2 turns.

cards.lore: Reaching the most important objective. Press X to end the simulation.
cards.name: Instant-Win Condition
cards.power: Deus Ex Machina — If you play this card for 5 consecutive turns without playing others, you win.

cards.lore: Do this small task every day for incremental rewards. You will forget why.
cards.name: Daily Quest
cards.power: Routine Trap — You must repeat your last action this turn.

cards.lore: Beat the clock. Efficiency is panic wearing a stopwatch.
cards.name: Time Trial
cards.power: Speed Gate — You must complete your turn in 5 seconds or lose all actions.

cards.lore: Don’t be seen. Don’t be heard. Don’t exist convincingly.
cards.name: Stealth Mission
cards.power: Detection Fail — If you speak, lose your next turn.

cards.lore: Select your personality from the available buttons.
cards.name: Dialogue Wheel
cards.power: Forced Choice — Opponent must choose from 3 scripted responses.

cards.lore: Press X not to die. Narrative tension outsourced to your fingers.
cards.name: Quick Time Event
cards.power: Reflex Check — Opponent must clap or tap instantly or fail action.

cards.lore: You cannot see the battlefield, only your assumptions.
cards.name: Fog of War
cards.power: Hidden State — Opponent plays next turn with cards face down.

cards.lore: Actions have consequences. Rarely used, always feared.
cards.name: Permadeath
cards.power: No Return — Destroyed cards cannot be recovered this game.

cards.lore: Progress is fragile. Memory is selective.
cards.name: Checkpoint
cards.power: Save State — Restore your hand to what it was 2 turns ago.

cards.lore: The curve was a lie. Welcome to suffering.
cards.name: Difficulty Spike
cards.power: Sudden Punish — Opponent takes double damage next turn.

cards.lore: Press A to understand. You will not understand.
cards.name: Tutorial
cards.power: Explain Mechanics — Opponent must narrate their next move step-by-step.

cards.lore: Congratulations. You did it. It does not matter.
cards.name: Achievement Unlocked
cards.power: Empty Reward — Gain 1 point for doing nothing meaningful.

cards.lore: Sit back and watch. Agency is temporarily revoked for drama.
cards.name: Cutscene
cards.power: Loss of Control — Skip your turn while another player narrates.

cards.lore: Freedom without direction becomes wandering.
cards.name: Open World
cards.power: Aimlessness — Draw 3 cards but must discard 2 randomly.

cards.lore: Skip the journey. Remember nothing.
cards.name: Fast Travel
cards.power: Teleport — Move any card instantly to another zone.

cards.lore: Progress measured in repetition, not meaning.
cards.name: Grinding XP
cards.power: Incremental Gain — Gain +1 for repeating same action.

cards.lore: The system changes after you learn it.
cards.name: Patch Update
cards.power: Nerf/Buff — Randomly weaken or strengthen all cards.

cards.lore: You are the tester. The system is unfinished.
cards.name: Beta Test
cards.power: Bugged Play — Random card fails to resolve.

cards.lore: You can continue. For a price.
cards.name: DLC Paywall
cards.power: Locked Content — Opponent must discard a card to play any card next turn.

cards.lore: Break the system. Reach the end before it notices.
cards.name: Speedrun
cards.power: Skip Everything — Ignore all conditions for one turn.

cards.lore: Do it again. But faster. But better. But why?
cards.name: New Game Plus
cards.power: Restart Stronger — Reset your state but keep bonuses.
